newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Techniche rises amidst Moore dust-up.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Techniche rises amidst Moore dust-up.

text.p: The shares of venture capital company Techniche Ltd rose sharply on Thursday, the stock partly benefiting from the publicity created through their association with Industry Minister John Moore, dealers said.
At 3.30 p.m. (0530 GMT), Technique shares were 24 cents or 10.6 percent higher at A$2.50 on turnover of 112,167 shares.

"The stock is up on anticipation of its listing on the Nasdaq exchange in the U.S. and is also benefiting from attention that has been refocused on the group due to the Moore controversy," a Brisbane-based dealer said.

Moore has come under fire from the Australian opposition who claim the minister has breached ministerial guidelines by retaining his ownership of shares in venture capital company Bligh Ventures Ltd, a company associated with Techniche.
At 3.30 p.m. (0530 GMT), Bligh shares were steady at A$2.10.
